title: Frozen-rule scalar retention: plug-in CLT with a consistent influence-function variance
statement: Conditional on a frozen provider s_hat and rule q, for an iid equally weighted evaluation sample with true scalar scores S_i and labels Z_i = q(s_hat(X_i)), the uncentred plug-in ratio eta_hat = sum_b m_hat_b^2/p_hat_b / v_hat (0/0 := 0 on empty cells) equals 1 - RSS/TSS exactly and satisfies sqrt(n)(eta_hat - eta) -> N(0, sigma^2) with sigma^2 = E[psi^2], psi = ((1-eta) S^2 - (S - c_Z)^2)/v, c_b = m_b/p_b, which carries the numerator-denominator covariance. The plug-in sigma_hat^2 = mean(psi_hat_i^2) is strongly consistent and sum_i psi_hat_i = 0 exactly; the Wald interval eta_hat +/- z sigma_hat/sqrt(n) has asymptotic level 1 - alpha whenever sigma^2 > 0. sigma^2 = 0 iff S given Z=b is supported on the roots of (s - c_b)^2 = (1 - eta) s^2 for every b (at most two atoms per cell), which includes eta = 0 and eta = 1; there the interval is unsupported. The interval is for the true retention Var(E[s | q(s_hat)])/Var(s); the proxy surrogate's population value is a different number and is excluded with probability -> 1.
assumptions: A1: every cell has positive population probability under the reference law
A2: the true scalar score has a finite fourth moment (automatic for bounded scores, e.g. mixture-fraction scores at interior reference points)
A4: sigma^2 > 0 (holds automatically when S | Z=b is atomless on one cell of positive probability)
the rule, provider, training data, reference point and K are frozen; the evaluation sample is independent of them, iid, equally weighted, and scores are never centred
the retained-information reading of eta requires E[S] = 0 and the quantized Fisher identity with q fixed in theta; the CLT itself does not use E[S] = 0
first-order statement only: no finite-sample or uniform rare-cell coverage guarantee; measured O(1/n) bias and n = 100 under-coverage are recorded in O6.7

proof_location.section: O6. Frozen-rule scalar retention: plug-in asymptotics and a consistent variance

role: the frozen-rule, scalar, oracle-score special case of OP27; separates evaluation uncertainty from proxy bias
warning: Bridge from the delta method (van der Vaart Thm 3.1; functions of sample moments, Cramer ch. 28). The closed-form influence function, the RSS identity and the sigma^2 = 0 characterisation are project algebra checked by the selftest and the CI pin, not independently audited. Does not resolve OPEN-RETENTION-UNCERTAINTY (vector scores, refitted rules, weights, no oracle) or OPEN-SCORE-PERTURBATION.
